g.text: You've been patient enough with me. If you still want that story of why I left the Britannic army... I probably owe it to you twice by now.
Couldn't help it, sorry. :P You were saying?
Everybody joins the army for a different reason. For me, I joined for... honor. For purpose.
I wanted to be a hero, like a Sol-damned fool.
Point being, I went in with big, grandiose ideas of what it meant to be a Soldier.
But I learned how much of a lie that really was.
Your role as a soldier isn't to THINK. It's to follow orders.
So, when I got sent in behind contested lines and told to kill all "potential enemy combatants"?
I did what a good soldier does. I followed orders.
I think I can see where this is going...
I don't know how many innocent lives we put in the ground that day.
When I went around demanding answers to why we'd just slaughtered innocents, the Brass threatened me with a dishonorable discharge.
Shut up. Do your job. Shoot your gun. Kill like a good soldier.
They were right. I shouldn't have been asking questions. I'm shit at getting to the bottom of things.
No, let me finish. I'M shit at getting to the bottom of a mystery. But you know who isn't?
And who worked as a Journo? And had connections to every major paper at the time?
So the deal was simple. Let me out on early retirement or the lid gets blown wide open. I wasn't important enough for them to care. They let me walk without a fuss after that.
So you joined the ICR after that?
It wasn't your fault, what happened.
I did. And fell into exactly the same naïve trap. I trusted leadership to care about civvies.
If I had a pound for every time Eleanor's said that to me...
Murder all possible infested innocents, no matter if it's true or not.
Have you ever tried listening to her?
Ooh, we could afford to put in a hot tub!
I just...couldn't. And neither could the rest of the Hex. And so - here we are.
Now you really are starting to sound like her.
I'm sorry you've had to go through all this.
Doing the right thing is always the hardest choice.
The thing with twins, is that no matter how far away you get from them?
They're still right there with you. Even when you're three thousand miles away behind enemy lines.
They find a way to weave their way into your lives.
Is there something else you're not telling me?
I'll be all right. I always am.
You don't have to be okay.
Do you... want to talk about it?
I appreciate that. It's a rough story. And one for another day.
Heh. You're right. That was bullshit. But it's a story for another day.
